# Peel UI — Complete Technical & Physics API Manual

This document provides complete implementation specifications, interfaces, and physics constants for all Peel UI primitives.

## Brand Design Tokens
- Canvas Background: `#08090a`
- Surface Body: `#101216`
- Surface Elevated: `#181b22`
- Structural Hairline Border: `#232730`
- Primary Brand Accent (Acid Lime): `#84ff00`
- Action / Destructive Accent (Warm Coral): `#ff553e`
- Primary Typography: `#f5f5f7`
- Muted Typography: `#8b92a0`
- Monospace / Telemetry: `font-mono tabular-nums`

---

## 1. Voice Pill (`components/ui/voice-pill.tsx`)

### Architecture
Standalone audio capsule component with real-time browser Web Audio API frequency analysis via HTML5 `<canvas>`. If microphone permissions are denied, it gracefully switches to harmonic speech simulation.

### Props Interface
```typescript
export interface VoicePillProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  accentColor?: string;       // Default: "#84ff00" (Acid Lime)
  stopColor?: string;         // Default: "#ff553e" (Warm Coral)
  iconColor?: string;         // Default: "#a1a1aa"
  background?: string;        // Default: "#101216"
  borderColor?: string;       // Default: "#232730"
  size?: number;              // Height in px. Default: 32 or 44
  shape?: "pill" | "rounded"; // Default: "pill"
  reach?: number;             // Expansion offset. Default: 10
  showTime?: boolean;         // Monospace elapsed timer. Default: true
  waveform?: boolean;         // Live FFT canvas. Default: true
  slideToCancel?: boolean;    // Horizontal drag to abort. Default: true
  cancelDistance?: number;    // Cancel threshold in px. Default: 64
  attack?: number;            // Rise envelope in ms. Default: 40
  release?: number;           // Fall envelope in ms. Default: 240
  sensitivity?: number;       // Gain multiplier. Default: 1.2
  floor?: number;             // Minimum bar height ratio. Default: 0.12
  openDuration?: number;      // Capsule expansion ms. Default: 220
  pressScale?: number;        // Active transform scale. Default: 0.96
  mode?: "auto" | "hold" | "toggle"; // Trigger mode. Default: "auto"
  holdAfter?: number;         // Threshold to distinguish tap vs hold in ms. Default: 300
  reactive?: "simulated" | "mic";    // Audio intake mode. Default: "mic"
  disabled?: boolean;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  onStart?: (info: { source: "simulated" | "mic" }) => void;
  onStop?: (info: { reason: string; duration: number }) => void;
}
```

### Installation
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peelui.com/r/voice-pill.json
```

---

## 2. Peel Card (`components/ui/peel-card.tsx` / `components/ui/folder.tsx`)

### Architecture
An asymmetric card component with an interactive corner flap that pulls inward via pointer drag or hover. Dragging reveals an illuminated underlayer containing raw code snippets, API keys, or telemetry.

### Physics Constants
- Drag Elasticity: `0.2`
- Spring Stiffness: `450`
- Spring Damping: `30`
- Max Drag Constraints: `{ left: -100, top: -100, right: 0, bottom: 0 }`

### Props Interface
```typescript
export interface PeelCardProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  tag?: string;
  codeSnippet?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}
```

### Installation
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peelui.com/r/peel-card.json
```

---

## 3. Slide to Confirm (`components/ui/slide-to-confirm.tsx`)

### Architecture
Hardware-accelerated slide-to-confirm track with spring recoil, dynamic constraints, zero React state in the drag loop, and decisive mechanical end-stop detent feedback.

### Physics Constants
- Drag Elasticity: `0.06`
- Release Spring Stiffness: `450`
- Release Spring Damping: `35`
- Release Spring Mass: `0.8`
- Magnetic Gravity Pocket: Drag threshold `>= 75%`

### Props Interface
```typescript
export interface SlideToConfirmProps {
  label?: string;
  confirmedLabel?: string;
  onConfirm?: () => void;
  onReset?: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  autoResetTimeout?: number;
  className?: string;
}
```

### Installation
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peelui.com/r/slide-to-confirm.json
```

## 4. Magnetic Split Button (`components/ui/magnetic-split-button.tsx`)

### Architecture
Dual-half action capsule with proximity separation, physical spring detachment, dropdown options menu, and magnetic snap-back settle.

### Physics Constants
- Separation Offset: `8px`
- Spring Stiffness: `500`
- Spring Damping: `32`
- Mass: `0.8`

### Props Interface
```typescript
export interface MagneticSplitButtonProps {
  primaryLabel?: string;
  options?: Array<{ id: string; label: string; icon?: React.ReactNode }>;
  onAction?: (actionId: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

### Installation
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peelui.com/r/magnetic-split-button.json
```

## 5. Tactile PIN / OTP Input (`components/ui/tactile-otp-input.tsx`)

### Architecture
High-contrast authentication input chassis with a single physical focus frame ("The Floating Lens") that glides smoothly across slots, vertical digit tumblers, and full mobile soft-keyboard support.

### Physics Constants
- Lens Spring Stiffness: `500`
- Lens Spring Damping: `32`
- Tumbler Drop Stiffness: `600`
- Tumbler Drop Damping: `30`

### Props Interface
```typescript
export interface TactileOtpInputProps {
  length?: number;
  initialValues?: string[];
  onComplete?: (code: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

### Installation
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peelui.com/r/tactile-otp-input.json
```

## 6. Privacy Shutter (`components/ui/privacy-shutter.tsx`)

### Architecture
Security key shroud featuring a physical sliding shutter plate. Dragging provides a temporary peek before the 80% detent; crossing 80% magnetically locks the shroud open, exposing the API key alongside an integrated clipboard copy button.

### Physics Constants
- Spring Stiffness: `500`
- Spring Damping: `32`
- Spring Mass: `0.8`
- Latch Detent Threshold: `80%`

### Props Interface
```typescript
export interface PrivacyShutterProps {
  apiKey?: string;
  maskedKey?: string;
  label?: string;
  onCopy?: (key: string) => void;
  onToggleLock?: (isLockedOpen: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

### Installation
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peelui.com/r/privacy-shutter.json
```

## 7. Web Audio Synthesis Utility (`lib/sound.ts`)

Synthesizes a 25ms mechanical switch click without loading external `.mp3` or `.wav` media assets:

```typescript
export function playTactileClick(freq: number = 800) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const AudioCtx =
    window.AudioContext ||
    (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext })
      .webkitAudioContext;
  if (!AudioCtx) return;
  const ctx = new AudioCtx();
  const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
  const gain = ctx.createGain();

  osc.type = "sine";
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime);
  osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(120, ctx.currentTime + 0.025);

  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, ctx.currentTime);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + 0.025);

  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(ctx.destination);

  osc.start();
  osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.025);
}
```
